findings.message: When `preflight_once` skips the probe it returns `[]` without running `ProviderLLM.preflight`. That method is the only place that sets `adapter.cli_version` (providers.py:962). `prepare_pipeline` and `_preflighted_llm` build a fresh `ProviderLLM`, with fresh adapters, on every dispatch. So every dispatch after the first runs with `cli_version = None`, and that null goes into each call's evidence record (`provider.cli_version`, providers.py:512). `evidence/views.py` groups by it, so per-version stats for every ticket but the first land under `None`. Before this change every dispatch recorded the real version.
findings.paved_road: When the probe succeeds, save each provider's `cli_version` on the `ProviderSession` (for example, store it with the key). On a skip, copy those versions onto the new `ProviderLLM`'s adapters, so no `--version` call is needed. Add a case to `tests/unit/test_preflight_once_per_session.py` that checks a second `prepare_pipeline`'s adapters still carry the version.
